changes.description: UX-01 intake (docs/plans/2026-10-22-ux-01-intake.md), the first documented stage of the task, after the Director's instructions to follow the documented tasks and stages and to begin UX-01 from the built design system. It records the authority (backlog UX-01, blueprint §10.1, §11.1, §16.1 and §18.3, UX standard §33–§36, decisions D17, D20, D21, D23–D26), what the design system already provides, the pieces each of the four reference screens still needs (crowded match, practical deckbuilder, Collection binder, pack presentation), the real-card fixture growth required by D25, boundaries, four questions for the Director with recommendations (direction studies, medium, match table tier, ink forms), default viewports and states, and the qualification design. No screen, component, fixture, dependency or workflow change.

Director answers to the intake questions recorded as decision D27 (decision register and the intake's answers section): one matched set of reference screens replaces the three alternative studies of blueprint §11.1; interactive Storybook screens built from the existing components and real catalog cards, labeled as demonstrations; a first static authored Babylon table scene in the crowded-match reference, against the agent's Flat-tier-only recommendation, with WEB-01 keeping lifecycle, quality tiers, measurement and context restoration and the Flat tier still required; quiet documented slots for ink-form artwork. The intake lists the consequences for the written design: scene code in packages/presentation, a lazy development-only boundary for the story, the semantic board and DOM presentation reading the same fixture, and software WebGL limiting automated scene checks.

Hosted runs re-observed from public GitHub job metadata with gh run view at about 04:44Z: run 39703969780 (pull_request, claude/ux-card-catalog at 4d9dfc7) design-system 01:08:50–01:11:15Z and foundation 01:08:50–01:24:52Z, both successful; the Director's fast-forward of main from 7a9e757 to 4d9dfc7; run 39705738273 (push to main at 4d9dfc7) foundation 01:27:05–01:42:43Z and design-system 01:27:05–01:30:22Z, both successful. Logs and artifacts were not downloaded.

Status lines in AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md now name the UX-01 reference screens as next, with the inspector (D24) following in UX-03, and record main at 4d9dfc7 with both merge runs; docs/README.md links the intake from the design-system index row; the UX-01 backlog row records the intake stage and its evidence (statuses of other tasks unchanged); the card catalog validation gains a dated merge-runs section; the documentation map classifies the intake as planning; the handoff is rewritten for this checkpoint.

The CardTile label finding noted during the 2026-10-21 capture (visible 'Printing' text against an 'Inspect …' accessible name, WCAG 2.5.3) was re-checked in packages/design-system/src/components/CardTile/CardTile.tsx: under D26 the tile renders only the card image inside a button named by action.inspect, with no visible text label, so the finding no longer applies. No source change.
